title: Sharp Generalization for Nonparametric Regression in Interpolation Space by Over-Parameterized Neural Networks Trained with Preconditioned Gradient Descent and Early Stopping
abstract: arXiv:2407.11353v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study nonparametric regression using an over-parameterized two-layer neural network trained with algorithmic guarantees in this paper. We consider the setting where the training features are drawn uniformly from the unit sphere in $\RR^d$, and the target function lies in an interpolation space commonly studied in statistical learning theory. We demonstrate that training the neural network with a novel Preconditioned Gradient Descent (PGD) algorithm, equipped with early stopping, achieves a sharp regression rate of $\cO(n^{-\frac{2\alpha s'}{2\alpha s'+1}})$, where $\alpha$ parametrizes the polynomial eigenvalue decay of the regular Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK), $\lambda_j\asymp j^{-2\alpha}$, and $2\alpha=d/(d-1)$ under the spherical uniform design considered here. translated_title: 通过预条件梯度下降与早停训练的过参数化神经网络在插值空间中实现非参数回归的锐利泛化
translated_abstract: 本文研究了利用具有算法保证训练的过参数化两层神经网络进行非参数回归的问题。我们考虑训练特征从$\RR^d$中的单位球面上均匀抽取的设定，且目标函数位于统计学习理论中常研究的插值空间内。我们证明，使用一种新颖的预条件梯度下降算法并结合早停技术来训练神经网络，可以达到锐利的回归速率$\cO(n^{-\frac{2\alpha s'}{2\alpha s'+1}})$，其中$\alpha$刻画了正则化神经正切核（NTK）特征值的多项式衰减$\lambda_j\asymp j^{-2\alpha}$，且在本文考虑的球面均匀设计下$2\alpha=d/(d-1)$。假设目标函数属于插值空间$\bth{\cH_K}^{s'}$，其中$s'\ge3$。该速率甚至比目前已知的近最优结果更为锐利。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合早停的预条件梯度下降算法，使过参数化两层神经网络在插值空间中的非参数回归达到锐利的回归速率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Preconditioned Gradient Descent algorithm with early stopping, enabling over-parameterized two-layer neural networks to achieve sharp regression rates for nonparametric regression in interpolation space.
